reason: Before the patch the Alert branch showed DisconnectIntegration gated only on `!delegationCredentialId`; it now renders CredentialActionsDropdown with `disableConnectionModification` (packages/platform/atoms/selected-calendars/wrappers/SelectedCalendarsSettingsWebWrapper.tsx:124-131), and `canDisconnect = !delegationCredentialId && !disableConnectionModification` hides 'Remove app' (packages/features/apps/components/CredentialActionsDropdown.tsx:68,113). The only caller setting the flag is the event-type advanced tab (packages/features/eventtypes/components/tabs/advanced/EventAdvancedTab.tsx:375), so broken credentials can no longer be removed there, though the main calendar settings page is unaffected.
